items.title: Adjacent pin events are distinct plain system-log lines
items.precondition: An isolated runtime is available with a conversation containing two or more consecutive pin or unpin events on the same calendar day.
steps: Open the conversation thread and locate two adjacent pin-activity events.
Confirm that each event retains its own pinned/unpinned action text and uses no card, border, background, icon, or side divider lines.
Confirm the 11px lines have a compact gap with no large blank band.
Confirm that no close control, count badge, or merged event appears.
items.expected: Every activity remains chronological and distinct as a compact, plain system-log line.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed the tested plain system-log presentation in the app.

items.title: Pin activity uses viewer-relative text across thread themes
items.precondition: An isolated runtime has the same conversation available in a gradient chat theme and the default/un-themed appearance.
steps: Open the conversation with a gradient theme such as pink and confirm the plain system-log text remains readable.
Pin a message as the signed-in user and confirm the line says You pinned a message.
Open the same conversation as the other participant and confirm the same activity says only the pinning user’s first display-name word followed by pinned a message.
Switch to the default/un-themed conversation appearance and repeat the readability check.
Confirm ordinary message bubble, reaction, day-separator, and system-log spacing did not change.
items.expected: The row is a readable plain system log; each viewer sees the correct actor-relative text; the change is isolated to pin-activity presentation.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed the tested viewer-relative and first-name-only copy in the app.

items.title: Frontend quality gates
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend/.
Run npm run lint in frontend/.
Run npm run build in frontend/.
items.expected: All commands exit successfully. Any pre-existing advisory is recorded separately from this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and npm run build each exited 0 in frontend/ after the first-name formatter.
items.notes: Lint reported six pre-existing warnings outside changed files; Vite reported its existing bundle-size advisory. Root typecheck and API build also passed. The documented root check:all script is absent.
